assessment.rationale: The candidate implementation at commit 09a758184c890eda200326a18fb166641194e32e satisfies all contract acceptance requirements. Independent test execution shows 11/11 tests passing with deterministic output. The fingerprint.py implementation correctly: (1) produces canonical JSON with byte_count, sha256, and text keys using sort_keys=True and compact separators; (2) computes lowercase SHA-256 digests of exact input bytes; (3) enforces the 4096-byte limit; (4) validates UTF-8 strictly; (5) fails closed with nonzero exit and stderr messages for all error conditions without emitting partial stdout; (6) uses only Python standard library (hashlib, json, sys, pathlib); (7) performs no network access. Tests verify ASCII/Unicode handling, byte-for-byte repeatability, empty and boundary inputs, and all error paths. Only the two allowlisted paths were modified. The implementation is deterministic and safe.

Error handling: all error paths call fail() which writes to stderr and returns nonzero without stdout emission
Standard library only: imports hashlib, json, sys; no network modules or external dependencies
